themes.disagreements: Strong effect modification in TTF1/TMB contrasts with weak signals for TP53; ventricular edema (339) lacks treatment prediction support unlike vasogenic edema (338).

themes.interpretation: Patient-level factors ranging from demographics and systemic health to cutaneous symptoms, primarily serving as prognostic factors or predictors for treatment assignment.
themes.name: Patient Demographics and Systemic Health Status

themes.disagreements: Tiotropium (318) and feature 321 are strong confounders, while Vinorelbine (343) and prior radiation (351, 352) act as effect modifiers; TKI and NGS (315, 316) show fragmented signals.
themes.interpretation: Prior medications and therapeutic interventions acting as confounders or effect modifiers, with varied stability across different pharmacological agents.
themes.name: Pharmacological and Prior Therapeutic History
